name: ordinate
description: Build dashboards and answer data questions in your Ordinate server through its MCP endpoint. Every figure comes from the server, never from the model.

server_url.title: Ordinate address
server_url.description: Your Ordinate server's address, with no trailing slash, e.g. https://bi.example.com

api_token.title: Personal API token
api_token.description: An ord_… token from Ordinate's API tokens page (/tokens). It acts as you, with your current role.
